title: TX queue vector generator: reject boolean integer lookalikes
description: Round-2 security review found expect_path uses Python equality, where false == 0 and true == 1. Malformed priority/deadline/capacity values represented as JSON booleans can therefore satisfy integer expectations. Require exact compatible types when comparing generated-vector expectations, excluding bool for integers.
acceptance_criteria: expect_path rejects bool when an integer is expected and reports a clear vector/case/path error; canonical generation and lint pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
